visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a large autumn maple tree covered in dense, orange-red leaves. In the foreground, white and orange text overlays are centered on the screen. A sliver of the creator's black hair and forehead is visible at the very bottom edge. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a young woman with long black hair standing on a brick-paved sidewalk. She is dressed in a heavy black duffle coat with toggle buttons and a dark green scarf. She holds a large red maple leaf extremely close to the camera lens with her right hand, creating a forced perspective effect that makes the leaf appear massive. (3) Through a series of jump cuts, she changes poses while maintaining the leaf's proximity to the lens. She smiles brightly, sometimes resting her chin on her hand or making small 'magic' gestures. In the background, a red mailbox and a few blurred passers-by are visible on the street under natural daylight. (4) The final shot shows her centered in the frame, holding the leaf with both hands near the camera before pulling it back slightly. She maintains direct eye contact with the lens, smiling warmly against the backdrop of the vibrant autumn tree.
